description: Mobiilidatavertailu — Finnish 5G Network Performance Dataset 2026 Suomen 5G-verkkojen mitattu suorituskyky 2026 is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Mobiilidatavertailu. This dataset contains aggregated measurements of 5G mobile-network performance in Finland, produced by Mobiilidatavertailu from open measurement data published through Traficom's Bittimittari service. Coverage: national (FI); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support communication-network and digital-infrastructure studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
